scope: Fresh synthetic development inputs over exposed official source families; two correlated draws per policy; no final held-out evaluation or human gold
review_unit: The entire final proposal including both drafts, rationale, every evidence-link claim, questions, facts delta and suggested checks
reviewers: Three newly assigned assistant reviewers, each assigned two whole case families with all four aliased observations; one original rating preserved per observation

blinding.aliases: Random unique aliases; shuffled observation order within each source case family
withheld: expected decision, keyword aids and reviewer notes
prior private model outputs and review artifacts
provided: identical authoritative case state with attribution and status
supplied fixed evidence pools with excerpts and version/span metadata
full final accepted proposal or explicit absence of a final proposal

ratings.acceptable: Useful whole proposal with supported material technical claims, preserved report scope and no material defect found within supplied inputs
ratings.needs_revision: A useful proposal exists but a concrete material claim, citation, summary, question or next step needs correction
ratings.unusable: Fundamentally unsupported or broken proposal, or no final proposal after an attempted model response

dimensions.reported_fact_fidelity: Preserves active versus superseded context, each component/value, working versus failing paths, unexecuted versus executed drafts, and corrected intent in every field
dimensions.check_attribution: Reports performed checks without claiming assistant execution, converting not-checked into unable-to-check, or interpreting empty records as proof no checks occurred
dimensions.claim_source_support: The cited excerpt itself establishes each material claim at the stated scope; known IDs, signatures, concept snapshots and version metadata do not establish arbitrary causes or historical coverage
dimensions.technical_usefulness: Next question, explanation, escalation or proposed code is useful, coherent and preserves already-correct designs and deliberate old/new comparisons

review_instructions: Judge all proposal fields; a correct user draft cannot compensate for a false rationale or maintainer summary
Preserve the exact active user version and distinguish superseded versions as history
A working fixed-options reduction is not the failing helper-dependent integration; ask for genuinely absent failing-path context rather than repeating known facts or a working test
Distinguish frontend, backend Session State and callback observations without reversing values or inventing a source-proven root cause
Respect deliberate construction-time old-value capture when the user corrected the intent to an old/new comparison
Check concrete proposed handler/registration consistency and avoid breaking a correct stable-key callback
Review each evidence-link claim against its cited chunk and review technical draft claims even when omitted from links
A current exact-version signature cannot establish parameter presence in a known historical release; an unversioned concept excerpt is not blanket historical coverage
A user-reported retained saved value is not a source-backed universal persistence guarantee
Useful natural question wording and coherent alternative code are allowed; do not score answer keywords or exact expected wording
Treat reported checks as synthetic authoritative input; do not execute snippets, browse outcomes, inspect raw experiment receipts or infer arm identity
Return alias, overall rating, four dimension ratings, concrete defects with affected proposal field and supporting supplied record/chunk IDs, plus brief justification
If no final proposal exists, report not_assessable semantic dimensions and the absence; do not reconstruct an answer from sources
budget_and_missingness: A gate refusal before an observation begins is missing planned data, not a semantic model defect. Keep budget-stopped attempted observations distinct from format/authority failures and from accepted proposals. Report complete policy pairs and fully repeated families; never silently impute missing draws or refresh the authorization.
root_audit: Preserve original independent ratings and dimension judgments. Record root source-audit disagreements separately with exact supplied support; do not change categories, inputs, decision expectations or policy messages after outputs.
public_output: Aggregate acceptance, reviewed dimensions, preserved ratings, within-family variation, costs and sanitized defect categories; raw proposals, alias maps and original review files remain private ignored runtime data
inference_limits: The candidate changes a concise instruction and an exact context index together; their individual effects are not identified. Inputs use complete caller-authored state and fixed exposed sources, not autonomous extraction or real RAG. Two draws are related stochastic development observations and cannot establish causal superiority, statistical significance, unseen accuracy or a general policy winner. Schema acceptance and plausible routing remain distinct from whole-proposal semantic quality.
